result.summary: The page is mostly visually consistent, but there are a few layout issues where content appears clipped or hidden at the screen edges and behind the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The restaurant card near the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar. The image continues underneath the nav, making the content look cut off and potentially blocking interaction with lower cards.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards end above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category filter row shows a partially visible pill clipped on the far right with no readable label, which can look like a broken element.
issues.suggestion: Add proper horizontal scrolling affordance, spacing, or fade treatment, or ensure the clipped pill still shows enough content to imply scrollability.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” cuts off the third card and its restaurant name at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, add a clearer carousel affordance such as consistent peeking, spacing, or a fade. Otherwise adjust card widths so visible items are not awkwardly clipped.
